The Cool Classmate XX Years Later...
synopsis: When she was a student, she was a beautiful but cool loner. But 10 years later, we are married...... and she spends her days being all lovey-dovey with me! This is a collection of two-panel stories about the moe gap between the time skip, and the way she is becoming more and more doting on me! (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Originally self-published, the series was collected into a commercial volume published by Kadokawa on 2024-09-20

title: Kawaihara Senpai wa Kawaii (Saotome-kun) ga Suki!
titleRomaji: Kawaihara Senpai wa Kawaii (Saotome-kun) ga Suki!
titleNative: 可愛原先輩はかわいい（早乙女くん）がすき！
synopsis: Saotome is a short boy who's not very good at sports. He thought that he would at least be able to get good grades, but starting high school, he is far from the top rank, and he feels depressed because he has nothing else to offer. He is consoled by Kawaihara-senpai, the beautiful student council president who is like a "perfect girl" that excels in sports and academics. She tells him that she has been at the top of her class since the entrance examination, and she offers to help Saotome study. However, as a condition for her help, she wants him to wear a girl's sailor suit uniform when studying with her… After school, a secret study session begins. (Source: Natalie, translated)

synonyms: Reincarnation of a Wicked Woman's Dark Past
The Dark Past of a Reincarnated Villainess
synopsis: Konoha Satou has a dark history. After all, she spent her teen years writing self-indulgent fantasy romance fics-like her Dark History. But since she’s become its most despicable villainess, remembering every last detail is now a matter of life-and-death. Having avoided the first couple of death flags, Satou’s suddenly left in the dark when a mysterious stranger returns from the Lily Kingdom-a character she doesn’t recall writing in the original script. Although Yomi claims to be her ally, can Satou really trust a character she knows nothing about in such a dangerous world? (Source: Yen Press)

synopsis: Dan-Jo is a freshman in a university and lives a monotonous life. On orientation day she goes to the warehouse on an errand for her senior and witnesses a broom that transforms into a human. From that day on, the Broom Ghost persistently asks for help from Dan-Jo, who she has never met, saying she has nowhere to go. In the end, Dan-Jo accidentally gives the Broom Ghost, the name 'Eundohae', and they live together in a small gosiwon. In return the Broom Ghost promises to make Danjo happy. (Source: BOMTOON, translated)

title: Akuyaku Reijou-tachi wa Yuruganai
titleNative: 悪役令嬢たちは揺るがない
synopsis: It has been half a year since Aini Mikkola, the saintess in training who who hails from a barony in the countryside, arrived at the Royal Academy. The school is in turmoil. The boys, the sons of aristocrats, are at the mercy of Aini's innocent, natural cuteness, while the girls are angry at her disregard for the manners of the aristocracy. In the midst of all this, there were three daughters who were dubbed "the villainesses," in reference to a popular story. Seraphina, the crown prince's fiancée and the daughter of an upright marquise. Sandra, the noble daughter of a viscount who made their wealth from commerce. Bernardetta, the brilliant daughter of the current Prime Minister's who is a marquise. When a sense of disquiet begins to grow in the school, these women finally stand up! To correct Aini's mistakes and to follow their own hearts. This is a record of the battle between the three "villainesses" and the saintly apprentices, a battle for the way of life of women. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Are You a Landmine, Chihara-san?
titleNative: 地雷なんですか？地原さん
synonyms: That Girl Is Cute... But Dangerous?
synopsis: It’s the start of a new semester, and high school junior Kuroki finds himself seated beside the girl everyone whispers about: Mai Chihara. With her gothic fashion, jet-black hair, and intense stare, Chihara is said to be a “landmine” girl or jirai-kei, the hyper-feminine, dark aesthetic often associated with yandere tendencies and unstable personalities. But when Kuroki accidentally draws Chihara’s attention, he discovers she isn’t nearly as unstable as people claim. Beneath the intimidating aura is a surprisingly sweet girl… if a little weird. Hesitantly, Kuroki begins to learn more about Chihara and her strange quirks. Is there more to her than her volatile reputation? Or is all the dark clothing just a red flag in disguise? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
